result.note: Tested the April 2026 World Bank upgrade of India's FY27 growth forecast, its stated drivers, and how it compares with the RBI projection.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about the World Bank's April 2026 growth forecast for India:
items: It raised India's FY27 growth forecast to 6.6% from its October estimate of 6.3%.
It cited recently signed free trade agreements with the EU and UK among the reasons for the upgrade.
The Reserve Bank of India's FY27 growth projection is lower than the World Bank's.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: The RBI is more bullish than the World Bank, at 6.9%, while Moody's is more cautious at 6.0%. Even after the upgrade, 6.6% marks a slowdown from FY26's 7.6%, with the West Asia conflict the primary drag.
questions.source: The World Bank raised India's FY27 growth forecast to 6.6%, up from its October estimate of 6.3%, citing robust domestic demand and recently signed free trade agreements with the EU and UK.
